text: Therapist Will Harper and his daughters Sadie and Sawyer are still struggling with their mother's sudden death when [a disturbed stranger, Lester Billings, turns up at Will's office|trigger|an outsider reaches in] and is soon found hanging in the art closet. Mould spreads through the house and Sawyer glimpses [a sinister creature under her bed|threat|monsters and creatures]. Lester's widow tells Sadie the thing [feeds off fear|wants|feeding on the living] and grief, and that [only light can ward it off|rules|faith and charms protect].
